path_merchant.title: TIMBER GRADES / REJECTED LOAD
path_merchant.left: The timber was accepted at the landing by grade. The tablet now calls it inferior.
path_merchant.left_facts:
GRADE AT LANDING: ACCEPTED
REVISED GRADE: DISPUTED
path_merchant.right: The council's builder says the beams will not hold the cut's retaining frame.
path_merchant.right_facts:
STRUCTURAL USE: RETAINING FRAME
REJECTION: REQUESTED
path_merchant.prompt: Does the grade mark stand, or does the load return?

choices.label: Certify the landing's accepted grade
choices.result_text: The accepted grade remains in force. The builder's structural objection is attached for later review.

choices.label: Hold the beams pending a load test
choices.result_text: Neither grade is certified. The retaining frame waits for a test that can establish whether the beams will bear its load.

choices.label: Return the timber to the guild
choices.result_text: The load is refused and returned to the boatmen. The council receives the timber dispute without a certified grade.

path_merchant.title: BOAT DEMURRAGE / DELAYED UNLOADING
path_merchant.left: Our boat waited three periods for the unloading crew. The charge is not charity; it is time spent tied to your quay.
path_merchant.right: The household claims the boat arrived outside its assigned landing window.
path_merchant.right_facts:
LANDING WINDOW: DISPUTED
CREW RECORD: INCOMPLETE
path_merchant.prompt: Which account will carry the delay?

choices.label: Enter three periods of demurrage
choices.result_text: The boat's waiting time is entered as a charge against the quay. The household's disputed landing window remains attached.

choices.label: Suspend the charge until the landing window is checked
choices.result_text: No demurrage is collected yet. The unloading crew's record and the assigned arrival window must be compared.

choices.label: Charge the delay to the boat
choices.result_text: The boat bears the delay because its arrival is not shown within the assigned window. The guild may contest that entry.

path_merchant.title: COPPER INGOTS / FALSE WEIGHT
path_merchant.left: These ingots passed the market balance yesterday. Today the council calls them light and counterfeit.
path_merchant.right: The council asks that the entire batch be held until the source is named.
path_merchant.prompt: Do you certify the mark, impound the batch, or split the risk?

choices.label: Certify yesterday's market mark
choices.result_text: The prior market mark is accepted for this batch. The council's weight objection remains recorded and the ingots may circulate.

choices.label: Impound all twelve ingots
choices.result_text: The batch is held until its source and weight are established. Neither the prior mark nor the counterfeit allegation is treated as settled.

choices.label: Accept the council's challenge
choices.result_text: The batch is entered as disputed and withheld from exchange. The boatmen must establish why yesterday's balance accepted it.

path_merchant.title: QUAYSIDE GRAIN / MISSING SACKS
path_merchant.left: The storehouse tally records forty sacks sent to the quay. Only thirty-six were entered on the boat.
path_merchant.right: The boatmen insist four sacks were moved to a second craft without a witness tablet.
path_merchant.prompt: Do you charge the landing, amend the tally, or demand a second witness?

choices.label: Charge the four sacks to the landing
choices.result_text: The four-sack difference is entered against the landing pending a witnessed explanation from the boatmen.

choices.label: Amend the storehouse tally to thirty-six
choices.result_text: The quay receipt becomes the accepted quantity. The original dispatch of forty remains attached as an unresolved discrepancy.

choices.label: Hold the shortage for a second witness
choices.result_text: No party is charged yet. A second craft's witness tablet is required before the four sacks can be assigned.

path_martial.title: DITCH GUARD / RATION SHORTFALL
path_martial.left: The ditch guards received half their barley. They will not keep watch on empty stomachs.
path_martial.left_facts:
RATION ISSUE: HALF
WATCH: AT RISK
path_martial.right: The storehouse says the guard roll contains names not present at the ditch.
path_martial.prompt: Do you certify the shortage, challenge the roll, or guarantee the watch?

choices.label: Certify the guards' ration shortfall
choices.result_text: The half-issue is entered as a shortage owed to the ditch guards. The disputed names remain subject to muster.

choices.label: Require a muster before issuing the balance
choices.result_text: No additional barley is released until the guard roll is matched to those present at the ditch.

choices.label: Accept the storehouse roll and close the claim
choices.result_text: The names absent from the muster are excluded. The guards' claim for the missing ration is denied on the present record.

path_martial.title: SPEAR REQUISITION / UNMATCHED COUNT
path_martial.left: The captain requisitioned twenty spearheads. The workshop delivered fourteen and claims the rest were never authorized.
path_martial.right: The council's tablet bears a smaller order, but its seal impression is incomplete.

choices.label: Certify the captain's twenty-head requisition
choices.result_text: The larger requisition is entered and the workshop's fourteen-head delivery leaves a balance due.

choices.label: Recognize fourteen until the seal is verified
choices.result_text: The smaller count governs provisionally. The incomplete seal impression must be examined before the larger order is recognized.

choices.label: Return the requisition for a fresh seal
choices.result_text: No count is certified. The captain and council must submit an order whose seal can be compared with the archive copy.

path_martial.title: WATCHTOWER / SUPPLY GAP
path_martial.left: The tower has no lamp oil or rope. The captain says the supply boat never arrived.
path_martial.right: The boatman has a receipt for delivery at the lower landing, not the tower.
path_martial.right_facts:
LOWER LANDING: RECEIPT
TOWER: NO ACKNOWLEDGMENT
path_martial.prompt: Do you hold the carrier, reroute the supply, or certify the receipt?

choices.label: Hold the carrier to the tower's missing receipt
choices.result_text: The supply is not accepted as delivered to the tower. The carrier must account for the gap between the lower landing and the garrison.

choices.label: Reroute the supply under a tower acknowledgment
choices.result_text: A new delivery is required and must be acknowledged at the tower itself. The earlier lower-landing receipt remains valid only for that landing.

choices.label: Certify delivery at the lower landing
choices.result_text: The carrier's receipt is accepted for the lower landing, not the tower. The garrison's missing supplies remain an open matter.

path_martial.title: CONSCRIPTION EXEMPTION / HOUSEHOLD CLAIM
path_martial.left: The captain says this household's exemption was never entered on the muster tablet.
path_martial.right: The council elder says the exemption was witnessed and the tablet misplaced.
path_martial.prompt: Does the missing entry cancel the exemption?

choices.label: Recognize the elder's witnessed exemption
choices.result_text: The household is provisionally exempted. The missing tablet entry is recorded as an archive failure requiring correction.

choices.label: Keep the muster active until a witness is named
choices.result_text: The exemption is not recognized yet. The elder must identify a witness whose account can support the missing entry.

choices.label: Suspend the household's muster pending archive search
choices.result_text: No service is demanded while the tablets are searched, but the exemption itself is not certified.

path_civil.title: BOUNDARY STONES / FARMER DISPUTE
path_civil.left: The boundary stone stands where the elder's copy places it. The household says it was moved after the flood.
path_civil.left_facts:
STONE POSITION: DISPUTED
OLDER COPY: PRESENT
path_civil.right: The household's field marks show a narrower strip than the council's levy map.
path_civil.right_facts:
FIELD MARKS: PRESENT
LEVY MAP: WIDER
path_civil.prompt: Which boundary does your seal recognize?

choices.label: Recognize the older council copy
choices.result_text: The boundary follows the elder's archived copy. The household's flood-shift claim remains attached and may be reopened with older field evidence.

choices.label: Hold the boundary until the field marks are surveyed
choices.result_text: Neither boundary is certified. A survey must compare the standing stone, household marks, and levy map.

choices.label: Accept the household's narrower field line
choices.result_text: The levy boundary is reduced to the household's field marks. The council's wider map remains on file as a disputed claim.

path_civil.title: CANAL WATER / SHARED ALLOCATION
path_civil.left: The upper fields received three turns of water. The lower households say their turn was skipped.
path_civil.right: The canal keeper claims the lower gate was blocked with silt and could not be opened.
path_civil.prompt: Do you assign a lost turn, a debt, or a new schedule?

choices.label: Enter one lost turn as a water debt
choices.result_text: The lower households receive a recorded claim for one missed turn. The silted gate remains a separate cause requiring labor.

choices.label: Order the gate cleared before assigning a debt
choices.result_text: No water debt is entered until the canal gate is inspected and the blockage is confirmed.

choices.label: Keep the upper allocation and deny the missed turn
choices.result_text: The existing three-turn allocation stands. The lower households' claim is denied on the current record.

path_civil.title: INHERITANCE TABLETS / DOUBLE CLAIM
path_civil.left: Two tablets name the same field allotment. One bears the father's seal; the other the household's later mark.
path_civil.left_facts:
CLAIM A: OLDER SEAL
CLAIM B: LATER MARK
path_civil.right: The household says the later mark records a settlement made before the father's death.

choices.label: Recognize the father's sealed tablet provisionally
choices.result_text: The older seal governs for now. The household's claim of a later oral settlement remains attached but lacks a named witness.

choices.label: Hold both allotments for witness testimony
choices.result_text: Neither claimant receives final recognition. A witness to the alleged settlement must be heard before the field is assigned.

choices.label: Enter the household's later settlement claim
choices.result_text: The later household mark is accepted provisionally. The older sealed tablet remains in the archive as a competing claim.

path_civil.title: MARKET VENDOR / FINE APPEAL
path_civil.left: The council imposed a fine for occupying the quay path. The vendor says the boatmen blocked the proper stall.
path_civil.right: The landing guild says the vendor's baskets narrowed the unloading lane.
path_civil.prompt: Do you uphold the fine, reduce it, or return the matter for witness?

choices.label: Uphold the two-shekel fine
choices.result_text: The fine stands because the unloading lane is recorded as obstructed. The vendor's claim about the blocked stall remains attached.

choices.label: Reduce the fine pending a lane witness
choices.result_text: The fine is reduced provisionally. Neither the obstruction nor the prior warning is treated as fully established.

choices.label: Return the appeal for a quay inspection
choices.result_text: The fine is suspended until the stall position and unloading lane can be inspected together.

path_religious.title: SACRIFICIAL SHEEP / COUNT VARIANCE
path_religious.left: The offering roll lists twelve sheep. The shepherd delivered ten and says two were rejected as unfit.
path_religious.right: The household says no rejection mark was made at the gate.
path_religious.right_facts:
REJECTION MARK: ABSENT
DELIVERY WITNESS: DISPUTED
path_religious.prompt: Do you certify the rejection, charge the shortage, or require a witness?

choices.label: Accept the two rejected sheep as unfit
choices.result_text: The offering roll is reduced by two. The gate's missing rejection mark is recorded as an omission requiring explanation.

choices.label: Charge the shepherd for the two missing sheep
choices.result_text: The full twelve remain due because no rejection was entered at delivery. The shepherd may still produce a witness.

choices.label: Hold the offering count for a gate witness
choices.result_text: No shortage is charged and no rejection is certified until the gate attendant is heard.

path_religious.title: RITUAL BEER / ALLOCATION DISPUTE
path_religious.left: The ritual brewer received less beer than the allocation tablet promised.
path_religious.right: The carrier claims three jars broke during unloading and were entered as loss.
path_religious.prompt: Does the loss stand against the carrier or the allocation?

choices.label: Enter three jars as carrier loss
choices.result_text: The brewer's allocation remains due, and the carrier bears the three jars reported broken during unloading.

choices.label: Accept the breakage claim and reduce the allocation
choices.result_text: The ritual allocation is reduced by three jars. The carrier's account is accepted without a separate breakage witness.

choices.label: Hold the shortage until the unloading crew is heard
choices.result_text: Neither the brewer nor carrier is charged yet. The unloading crew must establish when and where the jars broke.

path_religious.title: STOREHOUSE SEAL / INSPECTION
path_religious.left: The seal on the offering storehouse is intact, but its clay impression does not match the archive copy.
path_religious.right: The council asks whether the seal was replaced during the last inspection.
path_religious.prompt: Do you accept the seal, order a re-impression, or open an inquiry?

choices.label: Accept the intact seal and note the archive mismatch
choices.result_text: The storehouse remains closed under its present seal. The unmatched impression is entered for later comparison.

choices.label: Order a new witnessed seal impression
choices.result_text: The current seal is not accepted as verified. A fresh impression must be made before the storehouse is treated as certified.

choices.label: Open an inquiry into the last inspection
choices.result_text: The seal's status remains unresolved while the prior inspection and its witnesses are examined.

path_religious.title: FESTIVAL TITHES / UNRECORDED SHARE
path_religious.left: The festival tithe is short by one basket. The temple steward says the share was promised to the musicians.
path_religious.right: The council says a promise is not a recorded exemption.
path_religious.prompt: Do you honor the promise, recover the tithe, or amend the next roll?

choices.label: Honor the musicians' promised share
choices.result_text: One basket is recognized as an exemption for the musicians. The promise is entered, though the council's missing authorization remains visible.

choices.label: Recover the missing basket for the temple roll
choices.result_text: The full tithe is required because no exemption was recorded. The musicians' claim is left as a separate petition.

choices.label: Amend the next roll after hearing the musicians
choices.result_text: The current shortage remains open. Any future exemption must be entered before the next festival allocation.

delivery_mismatch.title: DELIVERY TALLY MISMATCH
delivery_mismatch.right_quote: {right_name} received {received}. The missing measure is disputed.
delivery_mismatch.prompt: Which entry will carry the unassigned difference?

choices.label: Record discrepancy
choices.result_text: The unassigned difference is entered.

choices.label: Force acceptance on paper
choices.result_text: The docket balances; the missing goods do not.

choices.label: Dock the carrier
choices.result_text: The carrier bears the shortage pending review.

damaged_consignment.title: DAMAGED CONSIGNMENT
damaged_consignment.right_quote: {right_name} found cracked seals or damp stains on the outer bundles.
damaged_consignment.prompt: Do you quarantine, release, or return the damaged consignment?

choices.label: Quarantine damaged share
choices.result_text: The affected share is held.

choices.label: Release all goods
choices.result_text: The full load is released despite the damage.

choices.label: Turn away at gate
choices.result_text: The shipment returns without entry.

subtotal_claim.title: ACCOUNT SUBTOTAL / CROSS-HOUSE CLAIM
subtotal_claim.right_quote: {right_name} claims the extra {discrepancy} belongs to another household roll.
subtotal_claim.right_facts:
CALCULATED TOTAL: {calculated_total}
CLAIM NOT ON THIS ROLL
subtotal_claim.prompt: Will you correct the sum, transfer the claim, or hold both rolls?

choices.label: Correct math; hold the line
choices.result_text: The sum is corrected and the claim held.

choices.label: Quietly transfer the difference
choices.result_text: The claim is paid without proper entry.

choices.label: Impound for adjudication
choices.result_text: Both rolls are held for a senior ruling.

goods_unreturned.title: GOODS OUT, UNRETURNED
goods_unreturned.right_quote: {right_name} recalls a spoken promise to settle after the next landing.
goods_unreturned.right_facts:
WRITTEN PROMISE: NONE
SPOKEN CLAIM: DISPUTED
goods_unreturned.prompt: Will the balance remain open, be credited, or block the next dispatch?

choices.label: Separate writing from claim
choices.result_text: The written balance stays open; testimony is attached.

choices.label: Credit the carrier anyway
choices.result_text: The spoken promise is accepted as settlement.

choices.label: Freeze next dispatch
choices.result_text: No goods leave until the balance is answered.

hazard_check_preventive.title: HAZARD / MAINTENANCE CHECK
hazard_check_preventive.right_quote: {right_name} says a crew can be assigned if the storehouse authorizes it.
hazard_check_preventive.prompt: Will you commit labor, issue silver, or record and defer maintenance?

choices.label: Assign labor
choices.result_text: Labor is committed to maintenance.

choices.label: Issue silver
choices.result_text: Silver is issued for repair materials.

choices.label: Record and defer
choices.result_text: Maintenance is recorded without allocation.

hazard_check_active.title: HAZARD / MAINTENANCE CHECK
hazard_check_active.right_quote: {right_name} can provide a crew if labor or silver is assigned.
hazard_check_active.prompt: Will you repair the hazard now or record the loss and defer?

choices.label: Allocate {repair_resource} and repair
choices.result_text: The hazard is repaired and its ongoing loss stops.

choices.label: Record loss; defer repair
choices.result_text: The hazard remains active; loss continues.
